data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 跑完再绕一圈
data.description: 河堤跑道旁，爱衣一手扶着栏杆，弯起一条腿拉伸。她看见你走近，点了点空着的步道，像是在提议再走一小段。
data.promptProse: On a riverside path, Mei wears a white-and-violet track jacket and black joggers. One hand holds the railing while the other draws her raised ankle toward her hip for a standing quadriceps stretch. Clear morning light falls across the quiet path and water.
data.animaCaption: Her supporting foot stays flat on the path while the raised leg bends behind her.
data.action: 扶栏杆做单腿站立拉伸
